agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Expected-origin commit identity is derived directly from current Git state and is never manually expanded from an abbreviated display.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first notification-receipt push guard used an invented 40-character expected-origin value based on Git's abbreviated display and rejected before push.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The guarded pre-push comparison returned origin_task_branch_changed while the remote branch remained unchanged.

correction.action: Derive the expected task-branch parent directly with git rev-parse HEAD^ and compare that machine value to the fetched origin branch.
correction.prevention_control: Task-branch push guards receive no caller-authored expected-origin object identity; the expected parent is resolved from Git in the same command.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects a manually expanded abbreviated expected-origin commit before any push.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Focused tests distinguish source-owned content-free terminal construction from prohibited raw runtime detail release.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first focused test incorrectly forbade the sanitizer's legitimate internal code-and-null-detail terminal constructor.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The static focused suite failed one assertion before the authorised Node attempt.

correction.action: Require the source-owned content-free constructor and PRESET_MOUNT_UNCLASSIFIED mapping while retaining exact source hashes.
correction.prevention_control: Raw-detail tests target released message, stack, cause, path, stream or environment values rather than schema-owned null-detail constructors.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects an over-broad focused test before the single Node process.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The clockwork transaction timestamp is copied from the machine creation clock or typed evidence and is never manually composed.

agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pre-validation comparison against the paired closeout timestamp and creation workflow identified that the intent value had not come from a tool reading.

correction.action: Replace recorded_at with the exact machine clock reading obtained immediately before the correction.
correction.prevention_control: Every new clockwork recorded_at field is populated directly from a tool-returned ISO 8601 clock reading, never from model-composed digits.
